provenance.citation: This work uses data from SPHEREx, a joint project of NASA JPL and Caltech, obtained from the NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA).
provenance.processing: IRSA IBE cutout -> reproject_interp (bilinear) onto north-up TAN grid; NaN = no coverage, non-finite IMAGE or VARIANCE<=0; FLAGS reprojected nearest-neighbour and NOT applied to pixels; lambda = WCS-WAVE at target (approximate, not calibrated CWAVE).

spectrum.method: forced aperture photometry, radius 9.0 arcsec (pixel-centre inclusion), median background annulus +9..+27 arcsec, errors from VARIANCE; no aperture correction
caveats: Each frame samples ONE wavelength at this position (linear variable filter).
No aperture/PSF correction: fluxes are aperture-limited, not total.
Saturated (OVERFLOW) points are not reliable fluxes.
Template classification is not computed in cached snapshots.

checks.label: OVERFLOW / saturation at position
checks.detail: 0% of 60 frames flag OVERFLOW in the central 3x3 px

checks.detail: 10 wavelength-matched cross-season pairs; 2 differ >5 sigma and >20%; max 16.6 sigma at 0.967 um (D1)

verdict.summary: A Gaia DR3 source without significant parallax is at the position: catalogued, but not necessarily a star. Rule-based summary of the checks above computed by the snapshot generator; checks marked 'na' were not evaluated. Not a discovery claim.
